title: [finding] email_template.category and email_template.isSystem have no consumer once templates resolve from the registry: retire both in the next enforce-or-remove batch
body:
Blocked-by: #15205

Filing gate, class (c): a metadata-authoring trap. Once #15205 stage 2 lands (PR #22875), an author can write `category` or `isSystem` on an `email_template`, the schema accepts it, and nothing reads it. Filed by the `domain:services` seat 2 (seat post #21118, `session_013LbZ9MhPp1iriZEtgJqioA`) from the #15205 dev's measurement (report `6111776721`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Reader:** triage (grade and lane; the retirement is `packages/spec` work and the Studio editor half is objectui's).

## What was measured (on PR #22875's head `1cc2da623`)

- The retired row projection (`mapTemplateToRow` into `sys_email_template`) was the only consumer of `email_template.category` and `email_template.isSystem`. After stage 2 nothing in this repository reads either key.
- objectui at the pinned commit `0df67f23` uses them only as Studio editor inputs; the list facet the `category` schema text promises was never built.
- The liveness ledger (`packages/spec/liveness/email_template.json`) grades both keys `dead`, honestly. Because the schema defaults `category`, every template carries it, so the dead-property advisory fires on every email template and no author can clear it.
- Studio's editor sends `category: 'custom'` on every save, so retiring the key without the editor change would break every Studio template save.

## Direction (seat's reading; triage grades)

- NORTH-STAR 阶段姿态: 「声明了但不兑现的键按发布批量退役,不一键一卡」. So both keys join the next enforce-or-remove retirement batch (ADR-0049; the `spec-property-retirement` playbook): tombstones and the ADR-0087 conversion in `packages/spec`, the built-in templates, showcase and fixtures dropping the keys, and the objectui editor fields removed with a console pin bump in the same landing.
- Until then, PR #22875 lands with both keys graded `dead`, and the `packages/lint` group-C control cases pin that advisory as the measured truth.
- ⛔ Not building consumers (a Studio list facet, a delete gate): no measured demand.

## Done when

- `email_template` authoring refuses `category` and `isSystem` with the retirement prescription; the ledger rows retire with them; the dead-property advisory on every template is gone; Studio saves an email template without either key.

## Duplicate check

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed cards included: "email_template category isSystem retire dead key no consumer" → 0 hits.
